scope.target: Discover reproducible task/grader inconsistencies and runtime faults; do not certify global correctness.

rules: A structural absence or narrow test alone is a coverage observation, not a confirmed defective verdict.
A static hypothesis must identify a prompt requirement, grader evidence and an alternative explanation.
A confirmed false acceptance requires a completed grading result and independently established task violation.
A confirmed false rejection requires a completed grading result and independently established valid solution.
Partial or stubbed executions must list substituted components and cannot be reported as complete environment reproductions.
Reward level or calibration alone does not prove an incentive reversal; examine ordering and effective training transformations.
Curated samples and heuristic selection do not support defect prevalence estimates.
An audit of current public artifacts does not establish behavior of historical training.

execution.login: Lightweight source/data inspection and job submission only
execution.image_specific_probes: Unresolved cases parked per latest user steering

next_stage_gates.source_to_probe: Specific conflicting behavior with a minimal reproducible test and bounded resource estimate
next_stage_gates.probe_to_environment: Reduced probe supports a meaningful failure hypothesis; pin image and use supported configuration
next_stage_gates.environment_to_training: Reproduced reward mismatch with independent outcome measurement; define a bounded training experiment

phase1_deliverables: Canonical per-row inventory and source hashes
Broader General prompt screening and selected rubric comparison
Executable bounded probes where feasible; parked cases clearly identified
